description: Needs at least one of category, city or query. Find event businesses — AV and production companies, sound, lighting, staging, backline, video, DJs, live bands, entertainment agencies, planners, caterers, photographers, videographers, rentals, decor, staffing, security and transportation — by category, city and free text. Categories: av_production, sound, lighting, staging, backline, video, dj, live_band, entertainment_agency, event_planner, catering, photography, videography, party_rentals, decor_florals, event_staffing, security, transportation. Listings are researched from public websites and returned from cache on this tool; each result has the official website, description, services, public contact details and source URLs. research.status "empty" means no cached market for that category and city yet; the scheduled seeder refreshes listings separately. Other research.status values reflect saved seeding state for that market. on_soundcheck=true marks a business that manages its own Soundcheck profile; its soundcheck_org_slug works with get_public_org for a public org profile. Contact details are what the business publishes; nothing is invented. decision_maker_count is how many decision makers Soundcheck has on file for the business (null until looked up); this public tool does not return their names or emails.

category.description: kind of event business; with a city, research.status reports cached seeding for that market

country.description: country name or ISO-3166 alpha-2 code, e.g. "US"

query.description: free text matched against business name, description and services

name: search_businesses

data.description: tool payload (API/composite/confirmation object); object, array, or primitive JSON

title: Search event businesses
